No entry offer

Listeners leave without a next step

Someone who saves a roommate-phase reel or binges three episodes, but isn’t ready to talk yet, has nothing to say yes to. You can’t follow up with people you never captured.

No first purchase

Most of your audience can’t say yes

Most people watching aren’t ready for private coaching yet. With nothing smaller to buy, they don’t buy anything, however much they trust you.

Unfiltered calls

Every call starts from zero

The only filter before your calendar is someone deciding to book. You spend call time finding out who is ready, instead of talking to people who already are.

1,598 posts and a weekly show build a lot of trust. Right now, anyone not ready for a private call has nowhere to put it.

Sound familiar?

The love is still there. The connection went quiet.

  • Most of your conversations are about schedules, bills and who’s picking up what.
  • You share a home and a calendar, but it’s been a while since you felt like a team.
  • One of you carries the mental load and ends up managing the other.
  • Bringing it up feels risky, so it stays unsaid and the distance grows.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

How couples slide into the roommate phase

Why it happens to good marriages, and why it isn’t one person’s fault.

The small daily moments that build distance

The habits that quietly turn partners into co-managers, and how to spot them in your week.

How to stop parenting your partner

How to hand back responsibility without nagging, keeping score or doing it all yourself.

How to start a real conversation again

A simple way to raise what’s missing without it turning into a fight.

Your first 7 days of reconnection

Small, specific steps to start this week, whether your partner joins the class or not.

Meet Karina

Hi, I’m Karina F. Daves

I’m a marriage and relationship coach. I’ve been married for 14 years and I’ve spent the last 6 coaching couples out of the roommate phase and back to a marriage that feels like a partnership.

Before coaching I worked as a social worker and taught women’s studies as an adjunct professor. Today 160k people follow along on Instagram, and I host The Relationship Reset Podcast every week.

Ad creatives · Video scripts · Meta

Video ad scripts

Script 1 · “Roommates”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here’s how a lot of couples end up feeling like roommates, without anyone doing anything wrong.”

Body

“It’s rarely one big fight. It’s years of talking about the calendar, the bills and dinner, and never about each other. The love is still there. The connection just went quiet. The good news: it’s a pattern, and patterns can change.”

CTA

“I’m teaching how couples get out of the roommate phase in a live 60-minute masterclass. It’s $17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, warm home setting, on-screen text “roommates” in terracotta.

Script 2 · “Stop parenting”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“If one partner ends up managing the other, this is for you both.”

Body

“When one person holds every reminder, every plan and every to-do, they stop feeling like a partner and start feeling like a manager. The other person stops feeling like a partner too. Handing it back doesn’t take nagging. It takes a different conversation.”

CTA

“I’ll walk you through that conversation in my live masterclass. Seats are $17. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a simple on-screen list: “reminders, plans, to-dos”.

Script 3 · “14 years”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“I’ve been married 14 years. Here’s what I wish more couples knew about the quiet seasons.”

Body

“Quiet seasons happen in long marriages. What matters is what you do next. The couples I coach who get out of the roommate phase don’t wait for a big trip to fix it. They change small, daily things first.”

CTA

“I’m sharing those daily changes live in Roommates to Partners. $17, 60 minutes, replay included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, close and personal, same setup as your Instagram reels.
